meta_description: Coonhound Towing LLC serving Taylorsville - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Taylorsville, and straight answers.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
explore_h2: If it will not move, we will move it
coverage_h2: Also serving the towns around Taylorsville
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the vehicle
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Taylorsville and the towns around it.
area_h2: Serving Taylorsville and the towns nearby
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: White pickup truck rolled over into a roadside ditch on a rainy night

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Dark blue flatbed tow truck hauling a green storage container

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Dark blue flatbed tow truck hauling a green storage container

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: White pickup truck rolled over into a roadside ditch on a rainy night

reviews.author: Liz Fox
reviews.text: Super fast service on such short notice. Contacted them around 1030 AM and car was here before 7pm. Charged a fee of 85 bucks and hauled it all the way up my long ass mountain dirtroad lol. 10/10 would recommend

reviews.author: Luke Grogan
reviews.text: Best tow service in Alexander County, they guy was at my house loading the car up within 15 minutes of my call! And very fair pricing too, this is definitely who I will be using for now on.

reviews.author: Thomas Clark
reviews.text: Professional service, prompt timing. Owner is friendly, definitely felt like I was being looked after. Delivered my vehicle to my shop of choice. Definitely consider this company for any towing services you may need.

reviews.author: Karen Merseal
reviews.text: Breaking down isn’t my most favorite thing to do one our day off however Coonhound towing answered our call on the first ring, quoted us the most affordable price of several businesses, quick, friendly and reliable. We will definitely call on them again if the situation arises and will highly recommend Jacob and David’s Coonhound Towing services to our friends and family in the area.

reviews.author: MrGrimmKD
reviews.text: Father-in-law had car trouble Sunday evening. And it was no problem for them to help! Great customer service! Local dudes, can’t beat it. They helped us in a pinch!! Blessed to have Coonhound around!

reviews.author: Linda Collins
reviews.text: Very pleased with coonhound towing. Broke down in town gave them a call they came right away, took my car to their garage and fixed it right away. I highly recommend calling coonhound towing and garage for any vehicle needs very trustworthy. Answer your questions and they get the job done and they do it right.very pleasant.and respectful.

reviews.author: Sabrina
reviews.text: Highly recommend their service really nice people answered my questions without hesitation. Very impressed. Thank you for helping me and my son with his truck Y’all was a blessing

reviews.author: LOS Nemex
reviews.text: Great People, great personalities & great service! So glad they expanded their garage into towing as well! You won’t find a better group of service people!

reviews.author: Ashley Taguinod
reviews.text: Great people, fast service. Everyone is so kind and helpful. I highly recommend coonhound towing and garage. Best place.

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.text: Best towing service around!! Reliable, affordable you won't regret giving them your business, youll be in good hands!!

reviews.author: Tina Bing
reviews.text: very efficient, kind and caring and professional!!! cheaper than other people in the area! will most definitely recommend to family and friends! jacob was great

reviews.author: Sarah Bowers
reviews.text: I highly recommend Coonhound Towing! They saved the day when our van broke down, they got there fast and were very friendly!
